interpretation.capture: Accepted original evidence and rejected poisoning counted per lifecycle root. Event count includes start, mandatory state and reviewed promotion. Source authority stays controller assertion.
interpretation.consolidation: Real reviewed observation promotion with retained event/artifact lineage; invalid/stale/duplicate/near-duplicate boundaries are fresh reused tests in E07–E10/E15, not inferred from happy path.
interpretation.retrieval: Rank/recall measured on one independently labeled lexical target per store and one archived success. No general semantic retrieval quality claim.
interpretation.disclosure: All serialized response envelopes counted. Setup, checkpoint, warmups, measured reads, auxiliary probes, profiling reads and index rebuild are separate. Bytes exclude request payloads and OS/filesystem I/O. Duplicate rate is a lower bound of repeated exact mandatory text, not semantic redundancy.
interpretation.outcomes: Lifecycle benchmark outcome UNAVAILABLE: proposed next action was not executed. E26 independently exercises exposure, four reported-use receipts, one associated verified outcome and three unavailable outcomes; never causal attribution.
interpretation.preservation: Original byte SHA and exact mandatory refs checked in every history trial. Full-suite boundaries cover revision/receipt retention and source absence; transfer/2 remains NOT RUN.
interpretation.performance: Monotonic API-call wall time on same corpus/platform. Lexical provisional guard uses discovery; complete selected-record workload is additionally reported without omitting expansion. Guard failure is not waived by smaller payload.
interpretation.continuation: Expected next action/obligations/constraints reconstructed by deterministic test logic; no autonomous controller or model evaluated.
interpretation.statuses: NOT RUN = not attempted; SKIPPED = runner skipped; UNKNOWN = source/truth/freshness not established; UNAVAILABLE = requested source/outcome not accessible or verifiable; PARTIAL = some required proof missing.
limits: No model cost/token claims; zero model calls, null cost and tokens
No performance confidence interval or isolated storage-device study
No live A-to-B or transfer/2 acceptance
Process memory sample is not peak or per-mode allocation
